content.Title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline

Publication Info.Journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology

content.Overall Theme: The guideline focuses on reviewing coronary revascularization in various clinical contexts, including acute myocardial infarction, ST-segment elevation, coronary artery bypass, and complications associated with these procedures.

genes.context: Reperfusion by primary percutaneous coronary intervention in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. Routine early angioplasty after fibrinolysis for ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction.
Routine early angioplasty after fibrinolysis for ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. Fibrinolysis is compared with primary PCI in suspected ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction.
